g.text: Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-301 Ribbon blender 6 cu ft (built in house) · rev B
SS 316L (ASTM A240 / A276); shaft 316 bar A276
Product contact #4, Ra ≤ 0.8 µm [32 µin]; welds ground flush; passivate ASTM A967
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5

svg.text: FRONT VIEW (from the front, y-; drive end right) 1:4
outer: RH left, LH right = to the centre
inner: LH left, RH right = to the ends
END VIEW (from the drive end) 1:4 shaft turns CLOCKWISE seen from here
angles from top dead centre, counter-clockwise seen from the drive end
blue A = outer arms Ø25, orange B = inner arms Ø20
ARM POSITIONS (x = 0 at the trough centre, + toward the drive end)
1. Build on the agitator fixture: shaft between centres on two V-blocks, a 360° index plate (or printed angle wheel Ø300) clamped on the Ø45 journal, a height
gauge on the table. Set each arm by its x and angle from the table.
2. Weld order: arms into the shaft sockets first (fillet all round, A 6 [.24], B 5 [.20]), alternate sides to keep the shaft straight; check runout at the journals
after every 4 arms, straighten cold if > 0.5.
3. Fit each formed ribbon into the arm slots (slot faces along the helix), clamp to the arm ends, tack, check the swept OD with a trammel from the shaft centre:
4. Weld ribbon to arms both sides (5 [.20] fillet), ground smooth and blended. No crevices: seal-weld the slot ends.
5. After welding: finish-turn the bearing, seal and journal diameters between centres (sheet P1-301-201 note 2); then sweep-grind the outer ribbon edge to Ø550
-1/-2 on the lathe with a tool-post grinder.
6. Polish all welds to #4, passivate. Check: total runout of Ø60 at the boxes 0.05, at the bearings 0.05; Ø45 journal 0.03. Balance is not needed at 40 rpm.
